function saveCellMetrics2nwb(cell_metrics, file)
% Synthetic HDF5 writer used ONLY to test routing/staging, not the NWB schema.
h5create(file, '/UID', size(cell_metrics.UID));
h5write(file, '/UID', cell_metrics.UID);
if isfield(cell_metrics, 'failExport') && cell_metrics.failExport
    error('ce:test:ExportFailed', 'Simulated adapter failure after creating output.');
end
end
